text:
OpsBot: ALERT: hosted-usw2-gpu-pool p95 queue-depth 78% over 5m. Admission control triggered for low-priority routes.
Sam: saw it, looks like continuous ramp starting ~10:02 UTC. p95 latency creeping too.
Mia: pulling dashboard — https://dash.internal.redwood/hosted-usw2/pools (refreshing). I see a surge from one customer shard, but also elevated short lived spikes across routing keys.
Anika: can someone run a quick query for queue by route?
Sam: ran PromQL: ```
sum by(route) (max_over_time(gpu_pool_queue_length{pool="hosted-usw2"}[5m])) | sort_desc()
```
Sam: top contributor is /v1/generate:shard-7 (~42% of added queue), then /v1/embed-batch (~18%).
Lee: is this traffic legitimate or replayed? any recent customer rollouts? @Kelsie can you check ingress logs?
Kelsie: checking, no obvious replay. One client did increase concurrency via a rollout earlier but within their committed throughput. I see more 429s coming from admission.
Sam: autoscaler didn't add capacity — see the scale logs: ```
[10:04:31] autoscaler: desired_gpus=120, available=118, provision_timeout=90s
[10:05:00] autoscaler: no new instances launched (quota limit)
```
Anika: quota limit? which quota — cloud provider or internal pool cap?
Lee: looks like provider quota in the region is at 118. We have reserved capacity requests pending in ticket INF-879.
Mia: short-term options: 1) move a small slice of traffic to euw1/backup pool, 2) bump admission throttles to shed more noncritical jobs, 3) emergency capacity request to cloud.
Sam: propose automated routing for low-priority routes to spill to hosted-euw1 where headroom exists. We can flip a routing policy for the next 10 mins and monitor.
Kelsie: I can patch routing weight on the delta router: ``routerctl set-weight --pool hosted-usw2 --route /v1/generate:shard-7 0.3`` then route ~70% to euw1.
Anika: also suggest temporarily reducing embed-batch concurrency to avoid long tail. Mia: can you draft the patch?
Mia: done, pushed a canary: ```yaml
route: "/v1/embed-batch"
concurrency_limit: 8
priority: high
```
deploy-bot: Deploy started for routing weight change (change-id: ch-3322).
Sam: applied in canary. Monitoring metrics: p95 queue down from 78% -> 52% in 2 mins. Latency p95 trending down.
Lee: still seeing admission events but fewer 429s. Good sign. Keep canary for 10m then promote if stable.
Kelsie: opened emergency quota ticket with cloud: CLOUD-REQ-501 — they acknowledged, ETA 2h.
Mia: Ops note: follow-up action items: 1) complete quota request (INF-879), 2) add automatic spillover runbook, 3) revisit pool reservation sizing for Q3. I'll create the tasks.
Anika: also log the incident into postmortems with traffic fingerprint so we can add a regression alert.
Sam: thanks all. will keep the routing canary active and post an update in 15m. :thumbsup:
OpsBot: RESOLVED: p95 queue < 60% for 5m, admission control reduced. (auto-note)
